technology_areas.name: Applied Artificial Intelligence
technology_areas.description: Applied Artificial Intelligence focuses on transforming the organization into an AI-First organization, aligned with the White House AI Action Plan, to revolutionize decision-making and operational efficiency, covering AI from back-office business functions to frontline warfighting.

technology_areas.name: Biomanufacturing
technology_areas.description: Biomanufacturing will harness living systems to enhance resilience and eliminate potential supply chain vulnerabilities, harnessing living systems for mass production of key materials.

technology_areas.name: Contested Logistics Technologies
technology_areas.description: Contested Logistics Technologies enable the department to operate and resupply in austere environments, ensuring seamless resupply and operational continuity in contested environments.

technology_areas.name: Quantum and Battlefield Information Dominance
technology_areas.description: Quantum and Battlefield Information Dominance provides warfighters with freedom of movement on the battlefield, even in degraded or denied environments, improving both longstanding radio-frequency technology and emerging quantum technologies to help forces communicate and navigate.

technology_areas.name: Scaled Directed Energy
technology_areas.description: Scaled Directed Energy accelerates research and development for this novel weapon system, moving high-energy lasers and microwave-beam weapons from promising small-scale demonstrations into mass production.

technology_areas.name: Scaled Hypersonics
technology_areas.description: Scaled Hypersonics accelerates research and development for this novel weapon system, moving hypersonic missiles from the current array of small-scale prototypes to mass production.
